mapper.select: SELECT id, schedule_id AS scheduleId, record_status AS recordStatus, consultation_time AS consultationTime, content_summary AS contentSummary, next_plan AS nextPlan, need_close AS needClose, update_time AS saveTime FROM consultation_record WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consultation_record ( schedule_id, student_id, counselor_id, session_no, consultation_time, record_status, content_summary, next_plan, need_close, create_time ) VALUES ( #{scheduleId}, #{studentId}, #{counselorId}, #{sessionNo}, #{consultationTime}, #{recordStatus}, #{contentSummary}, #{nextPlan}, #{needClose}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE consultation_record SET consultation_time = #{consultationTime}, record_status = #{recordStatus}, content_summary = #{contentSummary}, next_plan = #{nextPlan}, need_close = #{needClose}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
